findings.finding: An effective resale registration lets PIPE holders of 29,164,045 shares (about 47% of the ~61.7M outstanding), bought at about $12.00, keep selling into the 2026-09-25 session while still about 18% in profit at the $14.195 screen price.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration has been effective since 2026-09-09, so the supply can print on 2026-09-25 with no further filing; 29.2M shares against a 20-day median of about $6.6M a day (~0.45M shares) is roughly 65 sessions of volume, so the overhang cannot have cleared in the ten sessions since effectiveness.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since effectiveness the name's comparable falls went 09-10 -8.14% then +3.73%, 09-15 -6.08% then +0.88%, 09-23 -11.94% then -6.98% (today): the overhang has not produced a uniform continuation; the 11 comparable falls overall have a median next close of -1.29% (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: The price holds the distribution that has already happened, not the unknown remainder; with holders still above cost there is no pain point that stops selling, and if the overhang were spent a 7% fall on 0.65x volume would read as a vacuum likely to be bid rather than as continued distribution. How much remains is not observable (no 13G/A amendments filed since 08-10/08-11).
findings.independence: Merger 8-K confirms the ~29.2M PIPE share count and $350.0M aggregate price independently of the S-1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130606/000119312526330810/d309963d8k.htm; the SEC EFFECT notice dates availability: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130606/999999999526002925/xslEFFECTX01/primary_doc.xml
